decisions.reason: As a close-to-core Magento shop template with low carrying cost, it remains a cheap option to support hosting and shop customers even if demand is still uncertain.
This responsive website template is adjacent to the firm’s existing web project business and is inexpensive to leave available while the market response becomes clearer.
Premium customer support directly strengthens the firm’s main value proposition of expert service and therefore looks like a high-fit extension worth retaining.
The software version management tool builds on the firm’s technical platform and know-how, so despite development effort it is a strategically relevant option with good complementarity.

Because the data-processing-contract tool is relatively distant from the core hosting offer and the firm already has many nearer-term innovation options, management would be more inclined to redeploy resources if traction is uncertain.
